messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty — Incident #PD-8274 fired: HIGH - inference-queue backlog in us-east-1, autoscaler not keeping up. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-8274

maya: acked. I'm on it. Checking queue length + autoscaler status.

deploy-bot: autoscaler event stream: scale-request missed 3 consecutive windows for deployment inference-cell-prod, target_replicas=12 -> observed=4

maya: Confirming metrics https://grafana.redwood/prod/inference/queues?panel=backlog (spikes to 18k reqs/min). latency p95 > 2.5s :scream: 

raj: running quick check: ```kubectl -n prod get hpa inference-cell-prod -o yaml
# replicas: 4
# desiredReplicas: 12
# metrics: external.queue_length
```

sylvia: Looks like the external metric adapter lagged; KEDA scaler didn't see the recent queue delta. I'm going to bounce the metric-adapter pod. Maya, can you open fallback pool (warm pool) and route 20% traffic to dedicated-d1?

maya: On it. `kubectl scale deploy/warm-pool-dedicated --replicas=6 -n prod` — warm-pool starting.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/autoscaler-queue-exhaustion — step 3: route fallback, step 5: restart metric-adapter

maya: Routing 20% to dedicated-d1 (route-id: r-83f). Command: `scripts/traffic-shift --route r-83f --percent 20` — executing now.

raj: Restarted metric-adapter pod: pod/metric-adapter-7f8bc -> terminating -> recreated. Observability note: new metrics arriving in ~45s

sasha: Customer impact: throttling spike for enterprise cluster X (5% error increase), small number of requests dropped for small customers. Not full outage. Eng-sre, ping support for customer comms?

sylvia: Good call. @support-lead can you prepare a short note: "We are seeing intermittent slowdowns for inference requests; routing to fallback to stabilize. No data loss." Keep it 1-2 lines.

support-lead: Draft posted to #support: "We are mitigating a performance degradation for inference in us-east-1 by shifting traffic to a fallback pool. Some requests may see increased latency. We'll update when normalized." :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: warm-pool-dedicated pods ready (6/6). Traffic shift successful: 20% routed. p90 latency dropped from 2.5s -> 1.1s for routed traffic.

maya: Observed queue drain starting. Incoming rate stable. Autoscaler desiredReplicas now reads 11, metric-adapter telemetry healthy.

sylvia: Let metrics settle 5m then scale down warm-pool if stable. I'll stay on call for handoff. @oncall-night would you take over if we need follow-up? :phone:

oncall-night: I can take the 1hr handoff. Leave notes here and I'll watch dashboards.

maya: Notes: PD-8274, routed 20% to warm-pool, restarted metric-adapter, observed replication increase towards desired=12. ETA recovery ~10m.

incident-bot: Incident PD-8274 acknowledged by maya, severity downgraded to MEDIUM. Last update logged.

sylvia: Closing this thread after 30m stable. If queue rebounds reopen or escalate to platform.
